scope: Dock visibility, display switching and menu bar geometry.
approval: Maintainer approved integration and publication after visual review.

checks.command: Run the native installer in a KDE neon Wayland VM. Inspect the installed Dock and open the visibility selector.
Move the pointer to the second output bottom edge, disconnect the output and inspect the panel ID. Reinstall with keep-layout and compare mode and pins.

coverage_limits: Multi-output and keep-layout reinstall exercised in Tahoe. Golden Gate uses the same panel implementation.
